product.description: Monoprice™Cat8 Ethernet Patch Cable – Slim, Flat, U/FTP, 28AWG,Molded BootExperience Next-Level Speed, Reliability, and Streamlined Installation for Demanding NetworksLightning-Fast PerformanceUnlock the power of high-speed networking with the Monoprice Cat8 Slim Flat Ethernet Patch Cable. Designed for 25GBASE-T and 40GBASE-T applications, this cable delivers blistering data transfer speeds of up to 40Gbps and supports an impressive bandwidth of 2000MHz—up to four times faster than Cat7. Its backward compatibility with Cat7, Cat6A, Cat6, and Cat5 standards ensures seamless upgrades without replacing existing equipment. Whether you’re streaming, gaming, or operating a busy data center, enjoy superior signal quality and reduced latency on every device.Advanced Shielding & Anti-InterferenceReliability is key—each twisted pair is individually shielded with aluminum foil to minimize near-end crosstalk and block EMI/RFI line noise. This advanced protection helps ensure lightning-fast and error-free data transmission, even in crowded high-traffic network environments. It is ideal for homes, offices, and professional installations where stable connections matter most.Ultra-Thin Flat DesignSay goodbye to bulky, tangled cables. The slim, flat 28AWG construction offers exceptional flexibility and easy routing through tight spaces—under carpets, along walls, or behind equipment. Its flat profile also helps reduce snags compared to traditional round cables, keeping your setup neat, organized, and clutter-free.Power over Ethernet (PoE) ReadySimplify your installation with PoE technology, which enables both power and data transmission over a single cable. This reduces cable clutter and saves valuable space in server rooms and edge computing environments—eliminating the need for separate power cords.Universal Compatibility & DurabilityEquipped with standard RJ45 connectors, this cable connects seamlessly to switches, computers, laptops, modems, and routers. Built with stranded pure bare copper conductors, U/FTP shielding, a CM-rated PVC jacket, and a molded strain-relief boot for enhanced durability and long-term performance. Certified to UL® 444 and CSA C22.2 No. 214 standards, compliant with TIA/EIA-568-C.2-1 specifications, and DSX-8000 Fluke Channel Tested, it delivers trusted, professional-grade reliability.Why Choose
